remarks: Charming 3-bed/2.5 bath Cape on centrally-located Westport cul de sac with separate, legal one-bedroom, 534 sqft cottage. Vaulted great room with beams and fireplace flow into a sunny living room/dining room. Rustle up lunch in the country kitchen with its gas range, marble counters and breakfast nook. Separate home office plus half bath on the main level. Upstairs, the ensuite primary, with its balcony overlooking the great room, has a vaulted ceiling, double closets and a new ensuite bathroom with marble floors and stall shower. Two bedrooms on the lower level share a Jack & Jill bathroom. Attached garage, plus plenty of off-street parking. The screened-in porch overlooks the bucolic backyard while a stone patio is just waiting for your Adirondack chairs and a fire pit. The separate, rentable 1-bedroom cottage has a living space, kitchen area, loft, full bathroom, WD and private deck with garden area. Rent it out for roughly $2000/mo or keep it for parents, a nanny, an artist's studio or weekend guests. New fencing encloses the backyard, keeping your pets in and deer out. Unbeatable location that's close to everything: walk to Terrain for lunch, pop in for a mani-pedi and pick up dinner at Fresh Market on the way home. Bike to the beach or downtown, plus the MetroNorth train station to NYC is less than 10 minutes drive. And, of course, Westport's unbeatable restaurants, shopping and award-winning schools! Ask about the many sellers' updates and don't miss this one!
